messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends out a MIDI message using the numbers currently stored in.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: Inlet numbering starts at 0. Second inlet: Integer is stored as the velocity for either a note-on or a note-off message. If no number has been received yet, the velocity for note-ons is, and the velocity for note-offs is.

messages.name: in2
messages.digest: Third inlet: Note-on (1) or note-off (0) value
messages.description: Inlet numbering starts at 0. Third inlet: The number is stored as the indicator of whether outgoing messages should be note-ons or note-offs. If the number is not 0,will send out a note-on message. If the number is,will send out a note-off message with a release velocity. If no number has been received yet, it is initially(note-on).

messages.name: in3
messages.description: Inlet numbering starts at 0. Fourth inlet: The number is stored as the channel for the MIDI message sent out by. Channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is used as the pitch value for a note-on or note-off message, and the message is sent out the outlet byte-by-byte.In left-middle inlet: The number is stored as the velocity for either a note-on or a note-off message. If no number has been received yet, the velocity for note-ons is, and the velocity for note-offs is.In right-middle inlet: The number is stored as the indicator of whether outgoing messages should be note-ons or note-offs. If the number is not 0,will send out a note-on message. If the number is,will send out a note-off message with a release velocity. If no number has been received yet, it is initially(note-on).In right inlet: The number is stored as the channel for the MIDI message sent out by. Channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range.

messages.name: list
messages.description: The first number is the pitch value, the second number is the velocity, the third number is the note-on/note-off indicator (non-zero for note-on, 0 for note-off), and the fourth number is the channel. The numbers are stored by, and a MIDI note-on or note-off message is sent out.

examples.title: The numbers are formatted into a MIDI note-on or note-off message, which is sent out byte-by-byte
